articulation.label: ship
articulation.alt: ship: /ʃ/ → /ɪ/ → /p/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /ʃ/: Tongue blade just behind the ridge; air flows.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: chip
articulation.alt: chip: /tʃ/ → /ɪ/ → /p/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /tʃ/: Brief closure, then a narrow sh-like release.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
